title: Duplicate-Item Closet Density
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wardrobe:item
| stats count as items, dc(color) as colors by category brand
| where items>1
| sort - items
description: Highlights categories and brands where near-duplicate buying is clustering in the closet.
value: Duplicate density is an early signal of autopilot shopping and unnecessary accumulation.
implementation: Ingest wardrobe inventory with brand and category fields; identify duplicate-heavy groupings.
visualization: Bar chart of duplicate counts by category and brand.
grandmaExplanation: It spots where you keep buying the same kind of thing over and over again.
